tool.name: update-lists

datetime_rules.rule: Give endsAt as local wall-clock time in the configured timezone, formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, with no Z or offset: {{config.ai.instructions.timezone}}
Resolve relative times like "do dziś 20:00" or "na jutro" from the current time context of the conversation
Set an end time only when the user gives one or the list is clearly for a bounded time ("na dziś" ends today at 23:59:59); otherwise leave it out

usage_rules.rule: Call list-lists first to get the ids; never guess or reuse ids from memory
Batch all changes of one request into one call
When the user says they bought or did something ("kupiłem mleko"), tick the matching item with update_item done: true; do not delete it
Match items loosely by meaning, in the user's language; if a match is unclear, change nothing and report the ambiguity
Keep item texts and list names short and in the user's own words and language; one thing per item
Add to an existing list that fits rather than creating a new one; create a list only when none fits or the user asks
Pick among lists that are not expired; change an expired list only when the user names it explicitly
Never delete a list unless the user asks for it
If the tool reports a missing list or item, nothing was changed: call list-lists again and retry with the current ids
After a change, confirm it briefly; do not repeat the whole list unless asked

example.context: User says: "zrób listę zakupów na dziś: mleko, chleb, jajka"
User says: "kupiłem mleko i chleb" (list-lists returned items i1 "mleko" and i2 "chleb")
User says: "dopisz masło na górę i ustaw koniec na 20:00" (list l1)
